svg.title: An object on a spring as a simple harmonic oscillator
svg.desc: Five stages of a block of mass m on a spring of force constant k on a frictionless surface, each with its free-body diagram. (a) At x = X the block is momentarily at rest and the spring force F points left, toward equilibrium. (b) At x = 0 the force is zero and the block moves left at its maximum speed, −v_max. (c) At x = −X it is momentarily at rest and F points right. (d) At x = 0 the force is zero and it moves right at +v_max. (e) Back at x = X, the cycle repeats. In every stage the normal force N and the weight w balance.
